intro: Krueg Skullsplitter has come down to Feralas with companions, sent by their masters in Orgrimmar. Krueg plans a cloak for life-mate Korrin and asks you for ten Iridescent Sprite Darter Wings.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Well met, adventurer. I've traveled with my companions down to the Feralas on a mission for our Orgrimmar masters.

My life-mate Korrin finds great pleasure in new clothing, so I aim to make her a new cloak adorned with the gossamer wings of faerie dragons. Would you be able to help me? Sprite darters with gorgeous wings I want are west of Camp Mojache.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The sprite darters can be dangerous critters when provoked. Be careful when dealing with them, adventurer. And be even more careful of any night elves in the area. The pestering fools tend to hold up in the forests also.
When you've gotten enough of the wings, let me know, I'll be sure to reward you well!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Wonderful, adventurer! These will do nicely. There are enough here to make a cloak for Korrin, and possibly even more! Thank you.
I hope the trip wasn't too dangerous? The area of Feralas is not known for being forgiving, but you've obviously done well enough.
